thread:
Elaine (design): Quick UX pass on run preview for structured outputs — noticed a couple of clarity/accessibility nits after playing with tool-calling + schema output.
Tariq (devex): Thanks! Can you list them out? screenshots or quick repro steps are super helpful.
Elaine (design): 1) When a function returns a small JSON object the preview shows a big raw blob. Feels noisy. 2) Keyboard focus jumps when switching between schema editor and run history — hard to keep context. 3) The primary action says `Run` but in some places `Invoke` is used — inconsistent.
Jia (eng): I noticed the same jump — it's the panel re-rendering and forcing focus to the top node. I can try to keep focus anchored to the previously focused element.
Sam (accessibility): For the raw blob, we should provide a condensed card view with an expander and also add `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` to the toggle. Also need clear `aria-label` on the copy/clipboard button.
Elaine (design): Sketch idea: condensed card shows keys + truncated values inline, with an affordance to "Expand JSON" that opens a side panel that preserves run metadata (model, temperature, route). Keeps the run history list compact.
Tariq (devex): Love that. For copy action we can use `aria-label="Copy structured output"`. Jia, can you wire that and the focus-preserve fix into a small patch?
Jia (eng): Yep. Quick patch plan: 1) render compact preview for objects < 6 keys, 2) keep a focusRef and restore it after re-render, 3) add `aria-label` strings. I'll open a PR.
devex-bot: new PR opened by jia: https://git.redwood/infer/pulls/428 (WIP)
Sam (accessibility): Quick wording nit: instead of "Expand JSON" use "Show structured output" — less technical for new users. Also the tooltip for the copy button should read "Copy output as JSON" (not just "Copy").
Elaine (design): Agree on wording. Also replace a few instances of `Invoke` with `Run` in the run history toolbar — will post a tiny diff of copy changes.
Tariq (devex): Could we A/B test the compact vs full-by-default behavior? Some power users prefer raw output. We can surface a toggle in the playground preferences.
Jia (eng): Good call. I'll add a user setting `output_view: compact | raw` and default to compact for new signups. PR will include a feature flag.
Elaine (design): One more accessibility note: when expanding the item, ensure the expanded panel receives focus and that screen readers announce the run metadata. Use a live region for status like "Run details expanded".
Sam (accessibility): Yep — `role="region" aria-live="polite"` + label. Also ensure keyboard shortcut `e` toggles expand when focus is on an item (add to docs).
Tariq (devex): Assigning owners: Jia for implementation, Sam for accessibility review, Elaine I'll handle copy and mockups. I'll attach visual examples in the PR.
Elaine (design): Added a 2-up mockup in Figma: https://figma.com/file/zzz123/playground-compact-preview (notes in the comments).
Jia (eng): Working on PR now. ETA EOD tomorrow for initial changes.
Tariq (devex): Awesome — thanks all. We'll sync in next devex weekly to check metrics (click-to-expand, copy button use).
Sam (accessibility): I'll run screen reader pass once PR is up. :+1:
Elaine (design): Great — thanks team!
